agent_explanation: Shrunk failure is a near-collision of the two most massive bodies (1 and 2, ~17.7M each). By step 24 they are 1.13 apart, by step 25 0.72 apart, by step 26 0.336 apart - comparable to the softening length 0.3 - producing very large mutual acceleration. With dt=0.026 and only 6 substeps the leapfrog integration cannot resolve the rapidly varying softened potential, so kinetic energy jumps from 1864 to 2682 and potential from -1762 to -2730 between steps 25-26, dropping total energy from +102.4 to -47.3 and exceeding the 2% energy tolerance (change 126.87 > limit 108.31). Halving dt (same 26 steps, 6 substeps now sufficient resolution) removes the violation, confirming insufficient time resolution during the close approach as cause.
